## Pull request overview

This PR fixes pnpm version conflicts in GitHub Actions workflows by removing hardcoded version specifications and relying on the `packageManager` field in `package.json` as the single source of truth.

**Changes:**
- Removed explicit `version: 10` (or `version: 9`) from all workflow files
- Upgraded `shadcn-check.yml` from `pnpm/action-setup@v2` to `v4` for consistency
- The `pnpm/action-setup@v4` action now automatically reads `pnpm@9.0.0` from `package.json#packageManager`

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `.github/workflows/storybook-tests.yml` | Removed hardcoded pnpm version 10 |
| `.github/workflows/size-check.yml` | Removed hardcoded pnpm version 10 |
| `.github/workflows/shadcn-check.yml` | Removed hardcoded pnpm version 9 and upgraded action from v2 to v4 |
| `.github/workflows/release.yml` | Removed hardcoded pnpm version 10 |
| `.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml` | Removed hardcoded pnpm version 10 |
| `.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml` | Removed hardcoded pnpm version 10 |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Removed hardcoded pnpm version 10 from all three jobs (test, lint, build) |
| `.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml` | Removed hardcoded pnpm version 10 |
</details>
